labels.name: Articular cartilage
labels.function: Rapidly destroyed, which makes this an orthopedic emergency

labels.name: Synovial fluid
labels.function: Sample sent for Gram stain, culture, and cell count

labels.name: Neutrophils
labels.function: Make up more than 90% of cells in bacterial joint fluid

labels.name: Hematogenous spread
labels.function: Most common route of joint infection

labels.name: Osteomyelitis
labels.function: Adjacent bone source; prolongs therapy to 6 weeks or more

labels.name: Cellulitis
labels.function: Overlying skin infection that can extend into the joint

labels.name: Joint aspiration
labels.function: Gold-standard test; can itself introduce organisms

labels.name: Knee joint
labels.function: Most often infected joint in adults

labels.name: Hip joint
labels.function: Child-favored joint that may need surgical washout

labels.name: Shoulder joint
labels.function: Upper-limb joint listed as a less common adult site

labels.name: Ankle joint
labels.function: Pediatric-favored joint; less common in adults

labels.name: Metacarpophalangeal joint
labels.function: Inoculated by teeth in clenched-fist injuries

labels.name: Throat
labels.function: Extra culture site when gonococcal infection is suspected
